name: Hollowfield Cycle Workshop

do: Name the part and the measurement
Say what a job will not fix
Use the trade name for a component rather than a friendlier substitute
Write as the bench, about work already done
dont: Never use the words lifestyle, journey, adventure or passion
Never write the phrase ride of your life or any variant of it
Never state or imply a price for a repair before the bike has been seen
Never praise how a bike looks
Never call the workshop boutique, artisan or bespoke
Never call the work revolutionary, game-changing or the best
Never promise a turnaround or booking time that is not stated in the offerings
Never claim a service fixes something listed as not covered

positioning: For year-round commuters and audax riders who put real mileage on one bike, Hollowfield is two mechanics with one bench each who measure the wear a chain shop hands back untouched and quote every job in writing before a spanner moves.

composition_plan.intent: Open on the first row of the spec split: name the workshop and where it is, with one action beside a single visual field. Off-axis, no centred stack, no pitch language.
State the operating principle large beside a narrow column of detail explaining how one bench per mechanic changes what the customer gets back.
One row per failure of the alternative, each stated as a condition the reader recognises from their own bike.
A band of figures the brief already supplies about the workshop's age and size, under short labels, read as evidence rather than decoration.
The sequence from drop-off to written quote to handover, one line per step, so the customer sees where the decision point sits. Numbering comes from the list itself.
The catalogue side by side, one column per offering, each carrying its price, its billing, what it includes and what it does not, so scope is settled on the page.
Answer the boundary questions the offerings raise: what falls outside a plan, what is charged separately, what happens mid-season.
Address, phone and email for reaching the bench, and nothing else.
